## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and unrelated files are excluded.
- [ ] Examples and compatibility claims match real public APIs/tests.
- [ ] English and Portuguese product docs were updated when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] No text implies an official Figma partnership or presents a mock as a real import.
- [ ] No credential, private URL, customer data, or authenticated Figma content is included.
- [ ] No package publication, release tag, or unrelated version bump is part of this PR.
